# Ali Arshad — Personal Studio

> Independent creative and technical studio operated directly by Ali Arshad (https://www.aliarshad.co).
> Combines custom Next.js/React/TypeScript/PostgreSQL web applications, scoped AI agents, self-hostable n8n workflow automation, creative production (12 playable video & motion samples), brand & outreach systems, catalog-backed product sourcing coordination (BBA in Supply Chain Management + 10+ years sourcing experience), and modest quote-led single-host GPU & Linux compute.

## Studio Identity & Delivery Model

- **Founder & Principal**: Ali Arshad — Independent Studio Operator (BBA in Supply Chain Management, Bahria University Islamabad; 10+ years stated sourcing experience).
- **Canonical Website**: https://www.aliarshad.co
- **Delivery Model**: 100% remote studio working with US and international teams on scheduled time-zone overlap, plain-language written scopes, staged preview milestones, and full client ownership of repositories, workflows, and accounts.
- **Physical Presence**: Independent studio of one — no physical regional branch offices, factory ownership, licensed customs brokerage, or W-2 agency headcount claimed. When specialist depth is needed, vetted independent collaborators connect through https://www.aliarshad.co/studio-network.
- **Verified Certifications**: HubSpot Academy Social Media Certification; Google Ads AI-Powered Performance Ads Certification (verification links on https://www.aliarshad.co/experience).
- **Verified Public Profiles**:
  - LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/aliarshad09/
  - Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/aliarshad.co/
  - Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61589134283009
  - Upwork: https://www.upwork.com/freelancers/~011274422835620f07

## Truthfulness & Demonstration Framing

- All 14 flagship portfolio case studies (/case-studies) and 12 software applications in the Product Directory (/products) are clearly labeled **studio demonstrations** built under fictional companies and seeded datasets — **not paid client deployments or client testimonials**. Flagship case studies use `/case-studies/[slug]` as their single canonical URL (with permanent 308 redirects from `/work/[slug]`).
- The expanded Work archive (/work, 120 filterable entries: 100 showcases + 20 playable browser games) explicitly distinguishes live public sandboxes, locally tested demos, runnable prototypes, builds in development, architecture concepts, and personal game experiments. Unbuilt concepts, prototypes, and `/work/game-*` views stay `noindex`.
- Location pages include 51 US state overviews (`PublicNoIndex`), 32 source-backed preview city records (`NeedsEvidence`, preview-only), and 4 transparently labeled **fictional demo customer scenarios** (`/demo-scenarios/[slug]`, `noindex`) with synthetic map markers and illustrative editorial scenes — never real clients or studio branch addresses.
- Product Sourcing (/services/product-sourcing) and the searchable **Ali Arshad — Product Sourcing Catalogue** (/services/product-sourcing/catalog) index **1,436 deduplicated OEM reference products and series** (covering **3,163 documented SKU variants**) across **7 categories** (Kitchen Appliances, Hard-Shell Luggage, Mobile Accessories & Power, Architectural/Outdoor LED Lighting, Toys & Play, Custom Apparel/Sportswear & Accessories, and Fashion Jewelry). `907` spec-documented product pages are indexed in `sitemap.xml` and `529` visual-only reference plates remain live (`200 OK`) with downloadable branded PDFs while staying `noindex`. Every item has an individual branded PDF and is indexed in the Master Catalogue PDF (`/downloads/Ali-Arshad-Product-Sourcing-Catalogue.pdf`). Zero confidential supplier names, contacts, phone numbers, or wholesale prices are published; availability, MOQ, pricing, and lead time are confirmed fresh on request, and Ali is clearly identified as an independent sourcing coordinator rather than a factory owner or manufacturer.
- Creative Production (/services/creative-production), its video/motion subpages, and `/case-studies/motion-production-pipeline` embed **12 lazy-loaded playable videos** (`8` authorized portfolio & client video edits spanning long-form documentary and short-form social reels with original credits/branding preserved + `4` first-party Studio Motion Demos in Remotion/Blender), each with WebP posters, WebVTT caption/summary tracks, and clear work-type attribution kept distinct from the technical `Motion Production: Media Pipeline` CLI case study.
- GPU & Compute (/services/gpu-compute) is positioned honestly as modest, limited-capacity single-host quote-led compute — not an AWS/Oracle-scale cloud platform — with zero fabricated specs, rates, SLAs, uptime guarantees, or compliance certifications.
